Clear search and restore saved filter defaults
Not sure what an icon means?

Search: hold the magnifying glass to switch between apps and domains. Domain searches show matching apps expanded.

Domains: tap a domain to allow or block it. Apply globally controls whether the rule covers all apps. Allowing a parent domain includes its subdomains.

Global lists: manage shared allow and block rules from the menu. App-specific blocks override global allows.

Filters and sorting: changes apply to this session. Set as default saves your choices for future sessions. Reset search and filters keeps your sort and saved defaults.

Rule delay: changes that loosen restrictions wait for the configured delay. Blocks take effect immediately. Info & controls > Rule delay sets a longer or shorter delay for one app; reductions wait the difference.

Pauses: use the app Pause button for one app, or turn the main switch off and enable Resume automatically for all apps. Protection stays active during the delay. Cancel or Resume in the global pause strip asks for confirmation.

Display settings controls the list tools and timestamps.
Android controls when your backup runs.

Your Google account
Use Phone backup settings to turn on Google backup and choose your account.

What is saved
Rules, global lists, pending changes, app preferences, themes and accountability partners. Traffic logs and downloaded updates are excluded.

When it runs
Android controls backup timing. DomainGuard cannot confirm that a backup has completed.

Restoring
Android may restore your settings when you reinstall DomainGuard or set up a new phone with the same Google account.
